title: The Molten River
text: A river of slow fire crawls across the valley, orange and black, steaming where it touches the air. Stepping stones of cooled rock bob on it, rising and sinking. Some sink and do not come back up.

options.label: Hop the stones across the fire and hope they hold.

outcomes.text: You make it across with singed boots and blistered feet.
A stone sinks, and the fire licks up to the knee.

options.label: The quickest goes first and calls the safe stones for the rest.

outcomes.text: They call every stone right; everyone crosses safely.

options.label: Wait for a frost-breathing wyrm to cool a bridge, hoping it does not notice you.

outcomes.text: It comes and cools a bridge. Then it sees you.
